armored_to_the_teeth.name: Armored to the Teeth
armored_to_the_teeth.tooltipTemplate: Increases your attack power by [V1] for every 108 armor value you have.

booming_voice.name: Booming Voice
booming_voice.tooltipTemplate: Increases the area of effect and duration of your Battle Shout, Demoralizing Shout and Commanding Shout by [V1]%.

cruelty.name: Cruelty
cruelty.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee weapons by [V1]%.

improved_demoralizing_shout.name: Improved Demoralizing Shout
improved_demoralizing_shout.tooltipTemplate: Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by [V1]%.

unbridled_wrath.name: Unbridled Wrath
unbridled_wrath.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a chance to generate an additional rage point when you deal melee damage with a weapon.  Effect occurs more often than Unbridled Wrath (Rank 4).

improved_cleave.name: Improved Cleave
improved_cleave.tooltipTemplate: Increases the bonus damage done by your Cleave ability by [V1]%.

piercing_howl.name: Piercing Howl
piercing_howl.tooltipTemplate: Causes all enemies within 10 yards to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

blood_craze.name: Blood Craze
blood_craze.tooltipTemplate: Regenerates [V1]% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike.

commanding_presence.name: Commanding Presence
commanding_presence.tooltipTemplate: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Battle Shout and the health bonus of your Commanding Shout by [V1]%.

dual_wield_specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual_wield_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by [V1]%.

improved_execute.name: Improved Execute
improved_execute.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the rage cost of your Execute ability by [V1].

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a 30% chance to receive a [V1]% damage bonus for 12 sec after being the victim of a damaging attack.  This effect does not stack with Wrecking Crew.

precision.name: Precision
precision.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with melee weapons by [V1]%.

death_wish.name: Death Wish
death_wish.tooltipTemplate: When activated you become enraged, increasing your physical damage by 20% but increasing all damage taken by 5%.  Lasts 30 sec.

improved_intercept.name: Improved Intercept
improved_intercept.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by [V1] sec.

improved_berserker_rage.name: Improved Berserker Rage
improved_berserker_rage.tooltipTemplate: The Berserker Rage ability will generate [V1] rage when used.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.tooltipTemplate: Increases your attack speed by [V1]% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

intensify_rage.name: Intensify Rage
intensify_rage.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Bloodrage, Berserker Rage, Recklessness and Death Wish abilities by [V1]%.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.tooltipTemplate: Instantly attack the target causing 0 damage.  In addition, the next 3 successful melee attacks will restore 2% of max health.  This effect lasts 8 sec.  Damage is based on your attack power.

improved_whirlwind.name: Improved Whirlwind
improved_whirlwind.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Whirlwind ability by [V1]%.

furious_attacks.name: Furious Attacks
furious_attacks.tooltipTemplate: Your normal melee attacks have a chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 25% for 10 sec.  This can stack up to 2 times.  This occurs more often than Furious Attacks (Rank 1).

improved_berserker_stance.name: Improved Berserker Stance
improved_berserker_stance.tooltipTemplate: Increases Strength by [V1]% and reduces threat caused by [V2]% while in Berserker Stance.

heroic_fury.name: Heroic Fury
heroic_fury.tooltipTemplate: Removes any Immobilization effects and refreshes the cooldown of your Intercept ability.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.tooltipTemplate: Increases ranged and melee critical hit chance of all party and raid members within 100 yds by 5%.

bloodsurge.name: Bloodsurge
bloodsurge.tooltipTemplate: Your Heroic Strike, Bloodthirst, and Whirlwind hits have a [V1]% chance of making your next Slam instant for 8 sec.

unending_fury.name: Unending Fury
unending_fury.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Slam, Whirlwind and Bloodthirst abilities by [V1]%.

titans_grip.name: Titan's Grip
titans_grip.tooltipTemplate: Allows you to equip two-handed axes, maces and swords in one hand.  While you have a two-handed weapon equipped in one hand, your physical damage done is reduced by 10%.

single_minded_fury.name: Single-Minded Fury
single_minded_fury.tooltipTemplate: When you dual wield one-handed weapons, you deal 5% additional damage and Slam hits with both weapons.

improved_heroic_strike.name: Improved Heroic Strike
improved_heroic_strike.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 3 rage points.

improved_rend.name: Improved Rend
improved_rend.tooltipTemplate: Increases the bleed damage done by your Rend ability by [V1]%.

improved_charge.name: Improved Charge
improved_charge.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of rage generated by your Charge ability by [V1].

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of all Stun and Charm effects used against you by [V1]%.

tactical_mastery.name: Tactical Mastery
tactical_mastery.tooltipTemplate: You retain up to an additional 15 of your rage points when you change stances.  Also greatly increases the threat generated by your Bloodthirst and Mortal Strike abilities when you are in Defensive Stance (More effective than Rank 2).

improved_overpower.name: Improved Overpower
improved_overpower.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by [V1]%.

impale.name: Impale
impale.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by [V1]%.

deep_wounds.name: Deep Wounds
deep_wounds.tooltipTemplate: Your critical strikes cause the opponent to bleed, dealing [V1]% of your melee weapon's average damage over 6 sec.

two_handed_weapon_specialization.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
two_handed_weapon_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by [V1]%.

taste_for_blood.name: Taste for Blood
taste_for_blood.tooltipTemplate: Whenever your Rend ability causes damage, you have a [V1]% chance of allowing the use of your Overpower ability for 9 sec.  1 charge.  This effect will not occur more than once every 6 sec.

poleaxe_specialization.name: Poleaxe Specialization
poleaxe_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to get a critical strike and the critical damage caused with Axes and Polearms by [V1]%.

sweeping_strikes.name: Sweeping Strikes
sweeping_strikes.tooltipTemplate: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

mace_specialization.name: Mace Specialization
mace_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Your attacks with maces ignore up to [V1]% of your opponent's armor.

sword_specialization.name: Sword Specialization
sword_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target with your Sword.  This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 seconds.

weapon_mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
weapon_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be dodged by [V1]% and reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by [V2]%.  This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

improved_hamstring.name: Improved Hamstring
improved_hamstring.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Hamstring ability a [V1]% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

trauma.name: Trauma
trauma.tooltipTemplate: Your melee critical strikes increase the effectiveness of Bleed effects on the target by [V1]% for 1 min.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.tooltipTemplate: Whenever you are struck by a Stun or Immobilize effect you will generate [V1] rage and [V2]% of your total health over 10 sec.

mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
mortal_strike.tooltipTemplate: A vicious strike that deals 120% Weapon Damage plus 169 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

strength_of_arms.name: Strength of Arms
strength_of_arms.tooltipTemplate: Increases your total Strength and Stamina by [V1]% and your expertise by [V2].

improved_slam.name: Improved Slam
improved_slam.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of Slam by [V1]% and reduces its swing time by [V2] sec.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.tooltipTemplate: Your Charge ability is now usable while in combat, but the cooldown on Charge is increased by 5 sec. Following a Charge, your next Slam or Mortal Strike has an additional 25% chance to critically hit if used within 10 sec.

improved_mortal_strike.name: Improved Mortal Strike
improved_mortal_strike.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage caused by your Mortal Strike ability by [V1]% and reduces the cooldown by [V2] sec.

unrelenting_assault.name: Unrelenting Assault
unrelenting_assault.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Overpower and Revenge abilities by [V1] secs and increases the damage done by both abilities by [V2]%.  In addition, if you strike a player with Overpower while they are casting, their magical damage and healing will be reduced by [V3]% for 6 sec.

sudden_death.name: Sudden Death
sudden_death.tooltipTemplate: Your melee hits have a chance of allowing the use of Execute regardless of the target's health state.  This chance increases with every hit until it occurs.  In addition, you keep at least [V1] rage after using Execute.

endless_rage.name: Endless Rage
endless_rage.tooltipTemplate: You generate 25% more rage from damage dealt.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood_frenzy.tooltipTemplate: Increases your melee attack speed by [V1]%.  In addition your Rend and Deep Wounds abilities also increase all physical damage caused to that target by [V2]%.

wrecking_crew.name: Wrecking Crew
wrecking_crew.tooltipTemplate: Your melee critical hits Enrage you, increasing all damage caused by [V1]% for 12 sec.  This effect does not stack with Enrage.

bladestorm.name: Bladestorm
bladestorm.tooltipTemplate:
You become a whirling storm of destructive force, instantly striking up to 6 nearby targets for 120% weapon damage and continuing to perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec for 6 sec sec. 

Damage is increased by 30% when only hitting one target.

While under the effects of Bladestorm, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities but you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless killed.

improved_bloodrage.name: Improved Bloodrage
improved_bloodrage.tooltipTemplate: Increases the rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by [V1]%.

shield_specialization.name: Shield Specialization
shield_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by [V1]% and has a [V2]% chance to generate 5 rage when a block, dodge, or parry occurs.

improved_thunder_clap.name: Improved Thunder Clap
improved_thunder_clap.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 4 rage points and increases the damage by 30% and the slowing effect by an additional 10%.

incite.name: Incite
incite.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Heroic Strike, Thunder Clap and Cleave abilities by [V1]%.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec.  After the effect expires, the health is lost.

improved_revenge.name: Improved Revenge
improved_revenge.tooltipTemplate: Increases damage of your Revenge ability by 60% and causes Revenge to strike an additional target.

shield_mastery.name: Shield Mastery
shield_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Increases your block value by [V1]% and reduces the cooldown of your Shield Block ability by [V2] sec.

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.tooltipTemplate: Increases your armor value from items by [V1]% and reduces the duration of all movement slowing effects by [V2]%.

improved_spell_reflection.name: Improved Spell Reflection
improved_spell_reflection.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by spells by 4% and when the ability is used it will reflect the first spell cast against the 4 closest party members within 10  yards.

improved_disarm.name: Improved Disarm
improved_disarm.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by [V1] sec and causes the target to take an additional [V2]% damage while disarmed.

puncture.name: Puncture
puncture.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the rage cost of your Sunder Armor and Devastate abilities by [V1].

improved_disciplines.name: Improved Disciplines
improved_disciplines.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall, Retaliation and Recklessness abilities by [V1] secs.

concussion_blow.name: Concussion Blow
concussion_blow.tooltipTemplate: Stuns the opponent for 5 sec and deals 0 damage (based on attack power).

gag_order.name: Gag Order
gag_order.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Shield Bash and Heroic Throw abilities a [V1]% chance to silence the target for 3 sec and increases the damage of your Shield Slam ability by [V2]%.

one_handed_weapon_specialization.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
one_handed_weapon_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases physical damage you deal when a one-handed melee weapon is equipped by [V1]%.

improved_defensive_stance.name: Improved Defensive Stance
improved_defensive_stance.tooltipTemplate:
While in Defensive Stance all spell damage taken is reduced by [V1]% and the chance you'll be critically hit by monsters' melee attacks is reduced by [V2]%.

Dodging, Blocking or Parrying an attack has a [V3]% chance to Enrage you, increasing Physical damage caused by [V4]% for 12 sec.

vigilance.name: Vigilance
vigilance.tooltipTemplate: Focus your protective gaze on a group or raid target, reducing their damage taken by 3% and transfers 10% of the threat they cause to you.  In addition, each time they are hit by an attack your Taunt cooldown is refreshed.  Lasts 30 min.  This effect can only be on one target at a time.

focused_rage.name: Focused Rage
focused_rage.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the rage cost of your offensive abilities by [V1].

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.tooltipTemplate: Increases your total Strength by [V1]%, Stamina by [V2]% and your Expertise by [V3].

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.tooltipTemplate: Reduces damage taken by the target of your Intervene ability by [V1]% for 6 sec.

warbringer.name: Warbringer
warbringer.tooltipTemplate: Your Charge, Intercept and Intervene abilities are now usable while in combat and in any stance.  In addition, your Intervene ability will remove all movement impairing effects.

devastate.name: Devastate
devastate.tooltipTemplate: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect.  In addition, causes 120% of weapon damage plus 58 for each application of Sunder Armor on the target.  The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.

critical_block.name: Critical Block
critical_block.tooltipTemplate: Your successful blocks have a [V1]% chance to block double the normal amount and increases your chance to critically hit with your Shield Slam ability by an additional [V2]%.

sword_and_board.name: Sword and Board
sword_and_board.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Devastate ability by [V1]% and when your Devastate or Revenge ability deals damage it has a [V2]% chance of refreshing the cooldown of your Shield Slam ability and reducing its cost by 100% for 5 sec.

damage_shield.name: Damage Shield
damage_shield.tooltipTemplate: Whenever you take damage from or block a melee attack you cause damage equal to [V1]% of your block value.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.tooltipTemplate: Sends a wave of force in front of the warrior, causing 0 damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets within 10 yards in a frontal cone for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Avatar
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Avatar. 
Avatar: Transform into a colossus for 10 sec, causing you to take 20% less damage and become immune to immobilizing effects.

enchants.name: Heroic Leap
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Heroic Leap. 
Heroic Leap: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 0 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

enchants.name: Siegebreaker
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Siegebreaker. 
Siegebreaker: Use your full strength to slam the target with your weapon, dealing 100% weapon damage and knocking it back. 

Enemies the target collides with are knocked back slightly and take 75% weapon damage.

enchants.name: War Banner
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: War Banner. 
War Banner: Throw down a war banner at your feet, rallying your allies.

Increases movement speed by 30% and reduces the duration of all incoming crowd control effects by 50% to all allies within 20 yards of the war banner. Lasts 10 sec.

You can Intervene to the banner.

enchants.name: A Quick Death
enchants.tooltip: Using Execute grants you 3% melee haste, 1% critical strike chance and increases your Bladestorm damage by 6% stacking up to 5 times and lasts for 20 sec.

enchants.name: Battering Ram
enchants.tooltip:
Your Slam applies a stack of Sunder Armor.

Your attacks ignore 5% armor.

enchants.name: Blades of Blood
enchants.tooltip: After using Charge your next Whirlwind or Bladestorm applies Rend to targets hit.

enchants.name: Blood and Thunder
enchants.tooltip: Thunder Clap refreshes the duration of your Rend on your current target and spreads it to up to 5 additional targets.

enchants.name: Bloodthirsty
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Bloodsurge
Bloodsurge causes your next Bloodthirst to gain 100% critical strike chance and to not trigger a cooldown. It no longer affects Slam. 

Bloodsurge has double the chance to trigger from Bloodthirst and Whirlwind but will only trigger from those abilities.

enchants.name: Brutal Execution
enchants.tooltip: Killing an enemy with Execute refunds 30 Rage and causes a bloody explosion, dealing 0 damage to enemies within 5 yards.

enchants.name: Cleaving Slam
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Cleave causes your next Slam to hit an additional target and cost no rage.

You can store up to 3 charges. In addition, your Cleave costs 5 less Rage.

enchants.name: Controlled Aggression
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Gladiator Stance
Requires Sword and Board
The damage of your Shield Slam is increased by 25% of your attack power and the chance to trigger Sword and Board is doubled. However, the cooldown of Shield Slam is increased by 3 seconds.

enchants.name: Counterpoise
enchants.tooltip: While above 50% rage, you gain 5% melee haste. While below 50% rage, you gain 3% melee critical strike chance.

enchants.name: Crackling Thunder
enchants.tooltip:
Your Thunder Clap electrifies the ground, dealing ${23*0.99)+(0*0.02} Nature damage for 4 sec to nearby enemies and increasing your critical strike chance against them by 5%. 

This damage generates additional threat.

enchants.name: Desperation
enchants.tooltip:
Increases your healing taken by 10%.
Increases your damage done against targets below 35% health by 8%. 

These effects are tripled when you are below 50% health.

enchants.name: Devastating Blademaster
enchants.tooltip: Your chance to Parry is increased by 3%. After parrying an attack your next Devastate deals an additional 0% damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

enchants.name: Dragon Warrior
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Dragon Roar
Dealing damage with Whirlwind reduces the cooldown of Dragon Roar by 0 sec.

Using Dragon Roar grants you Deathwish for 5 sec (if known).

enchants.name: En Garde!
enchants.tooltip: Using Mocking Blow increases your chance to Parry by 10% for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Going For the Kill
enchants.tooltip: Your Execute increases the duration of your active Rend by 4 seconds and Execute refunds any extra rage cost over 15.

enchants.name: Heavy Thunder
enchants.tooltip:
Your Thunder Clap deals 20% more damage when using a single Two-Handed Weapon.

Hitting a single target with Thunder Clap will cause your next Thunder Clap to gain 40% increase critical strike chance and cost no rage.

enchants.name: Here Comes The Big One
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Bloodthirst
Every fourth use of Bloodthirst now deals 75% increased damage.

enchants.name: Heroic Rush
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Heroic Fury
Your Heroic Fury ability now increases your movement speed by 50% and attack speed by 30% for 5 seconds instead of resetting the cooldown of Intercept. Its cooldown is reduced to 20 seconds.

enchants.name: Insatiable
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Rend increases the damage of your next Overpower by 8%, stacking up to 5 times. Using Overpower while it's active also grants you 5 Rage per stack.

Whenever your attack is dodged, gain the maximum amount of stacks.

enchants.name: Iron Guard
enchants.tooltip: Your successful blocks further reduce the damage you take from the hit by 15%.

enchants.name: Jab Cross
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Devastate
Dealing damage with Devastate increases the critical strike chance of your next single target melee ability (excluding Heroic Strike) by 20%.

Additionally, using Devastate against monsters has a chance to trigger the Improved Defensive Stance talent Enrage effect (if known).

enchants.name: Master of Arms
enchants.tooltip:
After using Overpower, Slam or Execute your next Mortal Strike deals 15% increased damage. Stacks up to 2. Lasts 15 seconds.

Increases your armor penetration rating by 8% of your Strength.

enchants.name: Onslaught
enchants.tooltip:
Using Colossus Smash allows your next Execute to be used regardless of the target's health. 

Damage of Execute against targets below 20% health increased by 20%.

enchants.name: Outrage
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Enrage
Your Enrage talent increases your physical damage by an additional 5%.

enchants.name: Overwhelming Rage
enchants.tooltip:
Your maximum rage is increased by 20.

You generate 20% more rage from damage dealt.

enchants.name: Power Slam
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Bloodsurge
Slam is now instant cast, no longer pauses your attack timer, but its damage is halved. 

It has a 50% chance to trigger 5 seconds of your Enrage talent and Bloodsurge (if known). Bloodsurge now removes the damage penalty.

enchants.name: Raging Onslaught
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Raging Blow
Increases the critical chance of Raging Blow by 30%. Your Bloodthirst criticals make your next Raging Blow cost no rage and trigger no cooldown.

enchants.name: Relentless Fury
enchants.tooltip:
While any Enrage effect is active your Heroic Strike and Cleave deals 10% more damage. The health cost of Bloodrage is reduced by 100%.

After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor the cooldown of Bloodrage is reduced by 10 sec.

enchants.name: Revengeful Block
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Revenge reduces the cooldown of Shield Block by 1 sec per target hit.

enchants.name: Revitalizing Revenge
enchants.tooltip:
Using Revenge while Enraged Regeneration is active extends its duration by 2 seconds and heals you for 8% of your missing health. 

While Enraged Regeneration is not active, Revenge reduces the cooldown of Enraged Regeneration by 0 seconds. 

These effects can only occur once every 3 seconds and do not work against players.

enchants.name: Roar of Dread
enchants.tooltip:
Your Demoralizing Shout overpowers your enemies with dread, dealing 241.92 high threat Physical damage and can no longer miss.

However, the cooldown of Demoralizing Shout is increased by 12 seconds.

enchants.name: Seismic Shockwave
enchants.tooltip: Using Devastate increases the damage of your next Shockwave by 15%. At full stacks, the range of Shockwave is increased by 5 yards and stuns for an additional 1 second. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Shield Finesse
enchants.tooltip:
Using Shield Wall resets the cooldown of Shield Block.

Using Shield Block resets the cooldown of Shield Slam.

Increases the armor you gain from your equipped shield by 30%.

enchants.name: Shield Master's Resolve
enchants.tooltip:
Taking melee or ranged damage while below 35% health grants you Shield Block for 4 seconds. This can only occur once every 60 seconds. Will not trigger if Shield Block is already active.

In addition, damage taken while you are below 50% health is reduced by 10%.

enchants.name: Skull Crusher
enchants.tooltip: Casting Slam reduces the cooldown of Death Wish and Bladestorm by 0 seconds.

enchants.name: Spell Block
enchants.tooltip: Shield Block also reduces all magic damage taken by 20%.

enchants.name: Sword and Thunder
enchants.tooltip: Your Devastate and Revenge have a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of your Thunder Clap and make your next Thunder Clap cost no rage.

enchants.name: Throwing Mastery
enchants.tooltip:
Storm Shield: Damage taken is reduced by 8%.
Critical strike chance of Thunder Clap increased by 50%.
Cooldown of Thunder Clap increased by 25%.
Using Storm Bolt empowers your next 2 Heroic Throw abilities, allowing it to be used without a triggering a cooldown and increases the duration of Storm Shield, granted from Storm Bolt by 10 sec.

In addition, Storm Bolt and Heroic Throw applies 2 stacks of Sunder Armor.

enchants.name: Thundering Blow
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Shockwave
When Shockwave hits an enemy affected by your Thunder Clap it unleashes an additional Nature strike for 15% of the damage dealt. Reduces the cooldown of Shockwave for each enemy hit by this additional strike by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 5 sec.

enchants.name: Titan's Fury
enchants.tooltip:
Using Whirlwind while above 50 rage grants you Titan's Fury. Using it while below 50 rage grants you Titan's Heroism.

Titan's Fury: Increases damage dealt by 5% for 10 sec.
Titan's Heroism: Removes the rage cost of Heroic Strike and Cleave. Lasts 3 charges or 10 sec.

enchants.name: Victorious
enchants.tooltip: Your Victory Rush deals 10% more damage and heals you for 10% health.

enchants.name: Victorious Stand
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Last Stand
Dealing damage with Victory Rush reduces the cooldown of Last Stand by 5 sec. 

Using Last Stand grants one use of Victory Rush.

enchants.name: Vigilant Vanguard
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Vigilance
Transforms your Intervene into Vanguard.
Vanguard: Charge toward the target of your Vigilance, forming a Vanguard. While you remain close you follow up their auto attacks with your own attack, dealing 150% weapon damage. This attack can only occur once every 3 seconds. Lasts for 15 sec.

enchants.name: Wingman
enchants.tooltip: Challenging Shout now decreases the damage taken by your allies by 10% and its cooldown is reduced by 60%.

enchants.name: Ambidextrous
enchants.tooltip:
Your Heroic Strike also hits with your off-hand weapon, dealing 60% weapon damage. 

After using Heroic Strike you deal 5% increased damage with your off-hand attacks for 8 sec, stacking up to 3.

enchants.name: Arms Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Doubles the Armor Penetration rating granted from Battle Stance.

enchants.name: Bloodbath
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Bloodbath. 
Bloodbath: For the next 6 sec your melee abilities deal 5 bleed damage over 5 sec and reduces the movement speed of the target by 30% for 5 sec.

enchants.name: Bulwark
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Bulwark. 
Bulwark: Raise a mighty bulwark that grants you 40% block chance and causes you to deal Physical damage to enemies in front of you every second, modified by your shield block value, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts for 6 sec.

enchants.name: Colossus Smash
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Colossus Smash
@s:1186361:-32:s@

enchants.name: Dragon Roar
enchants.tooltip:
Reduces the cooldown of your Whirlwind by -2 sec.

Teaches you: Dragon Roar. 
Dragon Roar: Roar explosively, dealing 765 Physical damage to nearby enemies and increasing your attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

Using Dragon Roar resets the cooldown of Whirlwind.

enchants.name: Enduring Aegis
enchants.tooltip:
While Shield Block is active your Shield Slam can hit an additional 3 targets. Using Shield Slam extends the duration of Shield Block by 3 sec.

Your Block Value is further increased by 15% while Shield Block is active.

enchants.name: Fury Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your chance to hit with your off-hand auto attacks by 6% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

enchants.name: Gladiator Stance
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Gladiator Stance.
Gladiator Stance: An aggressive combat stance.

While wearing a shield in Gladiator Stance, you can use any other stance abilities and use Revenge after critically striking. Additionally, Shield Slam no longer generates bonus threat.

Your Shield Block now increases the critical chance of Shield Slam by 30% and makes your Shield Slam hit an additional nearby target, but no longer increases your chance to block.

Effects that require Defensive Stance also works in Gladiator Stance.

Your next Thunder Clap sends out an aftershock, dealing 150% weapon damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A balanced combat stance that increases the armor penetration of all of your attacks by 15%. Reduces threat generated by 20%.

abilities.name: Bladestorm
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
You become a whirling storm of destructive force, instantly striking up to 6 nearby targets for 120% weapon damage and continuing to perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec for 6 sec sec. 

Damage is increased by 30% when only hitting one target.

While under the effects of Bladestorm, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities but you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless killed.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Charge an enemy, generate 15 rage, and stun it for 1.5 sec.  Cannot be used in combat.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Maims the enemy, reducing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 201 and causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Heroic Throw
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing 12 damage (based on attack power).  This ability causes high threat.

abilities.name: Mocking Blow
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A mocking attack that causes a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.  If the target is tauntable, also deals weapon damage.(This spell cannot miss)

abilities.name: Mortal Strike
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A vicious strike that deals 120% Weapon Damage plus 169 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing 120% weapon damage.  Only useable after the target dodges.  The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 185 damage plus an additional ${0.2*5*((0+0)/2+0/14*0)} (based on weapon damage) over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Retaliation
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 12 sec.  Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked.  A maximum of 20 attacks will cause retaliation.

abilities.name: Shattering Throw
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing 12 damage (based on attack power), reducing the armor on the target by 20% for 10 sec or removing any invulnerabilities.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blasts nearby enemies increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 30 sec and doing 192 damage to them.  Damage increased by attack power.  This ability causes additional threat.

abilities.name: Battle Shout
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The warrior shouts, increasing attack power of all raid and party members within 30 yards by 232.  Lasts 15 min.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The warrior enters a berserker rage, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage.  Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Berserker Stance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: An aggressive stance.  Critical hit chance is increased by 5% and all damage taken is increased by 3%. Reduces all threat generated by 20%.

abilities.name: Challenging Shout
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Forces all enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and his nearest ally.

abilities.name: Commanding Shout
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases maximum health of all party and raid members within 30 yards by 380.  Lasts 15 min.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Shout
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 146 for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Enraged Regeneration
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You regenerate 30% of your total health over 10 sec.  This ability requires an Enrage effect, consumes all Enrage effects and prevents any from affecting you for the full duration.

abilities.name: Execute
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 708 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 15 additional damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage).  Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

abilities.name: Heroic Fury
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Removes any Immobilization effects and refreshes the cooldown of your Intercept ability.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Charge an enemy, causing 0 damage (based on attack power) and stunning it for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Intimidating Shout
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The warrior shouts, causing up to 5 enemies within 8 yards to cower in fear.  The targeted enemy will be unable to move while cowering.  Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Pummel the target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Recklessness
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Your next 3 special ability attacks have an additional 100% chance to critically hit but all damage taken is increased by 20%.  Lasts 12 sec.

abilities.name: Single-Minded Fury
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When you dual wield one-handed weapons, you deal 5% additional damage and Slam hits with both weapons.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

abilities.name: Titan's Grip
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows you to equip two-handed axes, maces and swords in one hand.  While you have a two-handed weapon equipped in one hand, your physical damage done is reduced by 10%.

abilities.name: Victory Rush
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly attack the target causing 0 damage.  Can only be used within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor. Damage is based on your attack power.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.tooltipTemplate: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Defensive Stance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A defensive combat stance.  Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 5%.  Increases threat generated.

abilities.name: Devastate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect.  In addition, causes 120% of weapon damage plus 58 for each application of Sunder Armor on the target.  The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Disarm the enemy's main hand and ranged weapons for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Intervene
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Run at high speed towards a party member, intercepting the next melee or ranged attack made against them as well as reducing their total threat by 10%.

abilities.name: Revenge
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 723 to 883 damage.   Revenge is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Bash the target with your shield dazing them and interrupting spellcasting, which prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to block and block value by 100% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Slam the target with your shield, causing 447 to 469 damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target.  Also causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all damage taken by 60% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sends a wave of force in front of the warrior, causing 0 damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets within 10 yards in a frontal cone for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Spell Reflection
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Raise your shield, reflecting the next spell cast on you.  Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Sunder Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4% per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat.  Threat increased by attack power.  Can be applied up to 5 times.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Vigilance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Focus your protective gaze on a group or raid target, reducing their damage taken by 3% and transfers 10% of the threat they cause to you.  In addition, each time they are hit by an attack your Taunt cooldown is refreshed.  Lasts 30 min.  This effect can only be on one target at a time.
